page_title: GRA 1-1 GET | Granada CF v Getafe 11/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Alejandro Ruiz is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Getafe.
90+4' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

90+4' Getafe take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Getafe will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+1' Gaston Alvarez (Getafe) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Alejandro Ruiz has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
87' Luis Milla will be replaced by Domingos Duarte (Getafe).
87' Substitution. Mason Greenwood did his best and is replaced by Jaime Mata (Getafe).
87' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Borja Mayoral walks off the pitch to be replaced by Juanmi Latasa (Getafe).
84' Paco Lopez has decided to substitute Gonzalo Villar and he is replaced by Alvaro Fernandez (Granada CF).
84' The manager makes a subsitution with Famara Diedhiou (Granada CF) coming on for Myrto Uzuni.
84' The game has begun to heat up. Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.

83' Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by David Soria, who pulls off a comfortable save!
80' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Wilson Manafa (Granada CF) was quite harsh and Alejandro Ruiz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
79' Getafe can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
78' The game is interrupted as Jose Callejon (Granada CF) is flagged offside.
74' Paco Lopez prepares a substitution. Bryan Zaragoza is replaced by Jose Callejon (Granada CF).
74' Today's match ends for Lucas Boye who will be replaced by Sergio Ruiz (Granada CF).
72' Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Ruiz had an easy-decision to make.
71' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
70' The attendance for today's match is 18103.

69' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Alejandro Ruiz with no other option than to blow for a foul.
67' The Granada CF players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
65' A substitution has been made. Oscar Melendo goes off and Antonio Puertas (Granada CF) comes on.
63' Granada CF take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
61' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Getafe comes to nothing.
59' The corner is swung in but Getafe can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
58' Substitution. Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) has come on for Carles Alena.
56' Carlos Neva (Granada CF) has tested the patience of referee Alejandro Ruiz and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
56' Granada CF failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

56' Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Granada CF have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
55' The ball is behind the touchline and Getafe will take a throw-in.
52' Lovely run from Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF). He finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper, lines up a shot, but the keeper boldly launches himself to intercept the ball.

49' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
46' Jose Bordalas Jimenez makes a half-time substitution. Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez comes on in place of Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+8' The end of the first half.
45+4' 1 - 1 Goal! Carlos Neva shows great vision to find Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the top left corner. 1:1.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
42' Flag up against Mason Greenwood (Getafe). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
41' Carles Alena (Getafe) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
39' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
37' Luis Milla (Getafe) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul.
35' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) makes a strong challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul.
34' A raking crossfield pass from Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
31' Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
30' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.

27' Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and David Soria pulls off an easy save.
25' The ball is cleared after Mason Greenwood (Getafe) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
22' Nemanja Maksimovic (Getafe) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
22' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the middle of the goal, but Andre Ferreira pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
19' The game is interrupted now, Oscar Melendo (Granada CF) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
17' Referee Alejandro Ruiz sees the trip by Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
16' Granada CF are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
13' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
12' Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
9' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to David Soria, who smothers the ball.
8' It's a throw-in for Getafe.
5' The resulting set piece from Granada CF is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
5' Oscar Melendo (Granada CF) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders. Granada CF have a corner.
2' 0 - 1 Goal! Mason Greenwood passes the ball to the feet of Borja Mayoral (Getafe), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 0:1.
